Buddy process
1 buddy call. Lasted around 22 mins. No case, but I think trying to judge the fit and checking if I am really interested. -Started with telling the vertical and some info about himself. -Asked me if I am interested in joining Accenture. -Moved to my workex and asked how and if I did make any impact during my workex. -Asked that there is no mention of strategy in my CV, then how will you work in a Strategy role. - I had mentioned about Chess in my CV, so had a conversation about that. - Questions from my side.
Interview experience
1 round, 1 uncon type case/problem, 1 guesstimate. Online interview. - Started off with TMAY and what you know about Accenture. - What do you expect out of the internship - Case - (will share image of whatever I've written if possible) imagine humanity invents a way to instantly teleport anything and everything. What businesses will be affected positively and negatively. And how will it affect a person's daily life. - Guesstimate - Calculate the footfall of tourists in Taj Mahal in an year. - Any questions from my side. Done

Buddy process
1) Number of buddy calls - 2, One with a recently hired MBA graduate, One with senior having 5+ years work experience with Accenture 2) Buddy call 1 - Intro and TMAY, Why Accenture and Consulting, Asked me about my views on Consumer and Retail Goods sector. (10 mins call) Buddy Call 2 - Case Round Imagine you have 30 mins call with UAE based DMart store owner (network of stores). How would you pitch Accenture's solutions to the client in this limited time frame. Condition was you don't know much about this firm, so how would you go about this. This was unconventional case and required different approach. Correct solution according him was starting with seeing whether the company was listed or not, if listed look at their financial reports like balance sheets, income statements, etc. Now compare it with competitors and industry standards and then devise offerings

NA (Hold and Wait not triggered)

▶ Consulting Summers rep 83
TMAY / IntroductionWhy This CompanyGuesstimateWork-Ex Discussion
Buddy process
1) 1 buddy call (although some people had 2 buddy calls per division (IMU & GN) ) 2) Buddy call revolved around TMAY, Why Accenture and a Guesstimate. It is an interest gauging call and can have almost no effect on final selection.
Interview experience
1) 2 PI rounds (although it could vary, people had upto 5-8 in some scenarios) 2) Both interviews revolved around my workex in Data center industry as the partner interviewing me had also worked in the same field, in my Round 1 i showed interest in their Industry X vertical although i was shortlisted for Supply chain management under S&C vertical since i did have a brief stint in SIOP. Looking at my interest in Industry X vertical i was transferred to a different partner which worked in that vertical and he asked me questions on why are you interested in joining this vertical - i answered by highlighting my past SIOP experience and work with data could come in handy in such a vertical. If you show genuine interest in accenture's work they will also show interest in you hence it is very important to go through their website rigorously. I did not get any consult case to solve but many people did so it is better to be prepared.
source: 62nd Summers xlsx
